CostingElement.description: The costing package: tariff, prices, demand response and finance terms.

consumption_estimate.description: Estimated total consumption over the horizon, keyed by EECO utility ('electric'/'gas'; kWh / m^3). EECO needs it to price any tier other than a flat top tier.
consumption_estimate.title: Consumption Estimate

currency.description: Currency basis to use when no tariff is given; a tariff's own currency basis always wins.
currency.title: Currency

decomposition_type.description: Optional EECO decomposition of net electrical power and fuel usage into imports and exports on the tariff path (e.g. 'linear'), so the tariff's export charges apply. Passed straight to EECO.
decomposition_type.title: Decomposition Type

discount_rate.description: Annual discount rate (fraction, e.g. 0.08 = 8%). Used alone as the effective rate when interest_rate is unset; otherwise it deflates interest_rate into a real effective rate. An effective rate of 0 falls back to straight-line 1/lifetime.
discount_rate.title: Discount Rate

energy_prices.description: Optional native prices keyed by carrier or fuel name ('electrical', or a fuel such as 'natural_gas'). A carrier priced here is billed at that price instead of through the tariff, so a run with every carrier priced needs no tariff at all. Each price is flat over the horizon or given per time point.
energy_prices.title: Energy Prices

export_prices.description: Optional prices paid for exports, keyed like energy_prices ('electrical' or a fuel name). Each key needs a matching energy_prices entry and must not exceed it at any time point. A carrier left out credits exports at its import price.
export_prices.title: Export Prices

fixed_operating_cost.description: Fixed operating cost over the horizon, in the currency basis in force (a tariff's own, else 'currency'): non-tariff costs such as maintenance, labor, and chemicals. Distinct from the tariff's own fixed charge (which EECO includes in the electricity cost).
fixed_operating_cost.title: Fixed Operating Cost

interest_rate.description: Optional annual cost of capital (fraction, e.g. 0.06). When given, the capital recovery factor uses the effective rate (1 + interest_rate) / (1 + discount_rate) - 1. Omit to use discount_rate alone.
interest_rate.title: Interest Rate

lifetime_years.description: Plant lifetime in years (> 0), used with the effective rate to form the capital recovery factor that annualizes capital cost.
lifetime_years.title: Lifetime Years

name.description: Name of the costing block on the model.
name.title: Name

prorate_monthly_charges.description: Prorate a tariff's monthly-assessed demand charge and fixed (customer) charge to the horizon length when the horizon is shorter than the calendar month it starts in. False bills the full monthly charges.
prorate_monthly_charges.title: Prorate Monthly Charges

tariff_source.description: Where the EECO tariff comes from: one file or tag, a list of them to merge, or a mapping of EECO utility ('electric'/'gas') to file to merge and also assign each file to a utility. Omit to price every carrier from energy_prices instead.
tariff_source.title: Tariff Source
